title: Most Heisman Winners by School: Where Does Oklahoma Rank?
question: Which school has the most Heisman Trophy winners, and how many does Oklahoma have?
answer: Oklahoma has seven Heisman Trophy winners, tied with Notre Dame and Ohio State for second-most behind USC's eight through the 2025 award. OU is also the first school with Heisman-winning quarterbacks in back-to-back seasons.
summary: Oklahoma has seven Heisman winners, tied with Notre Dame and Ohio State behind USC's eight. Here is the full list and the back-to-back QB first OU owns.
body: Oklahoma sits in the top tier of Heisman schools with seven winners, tied with Notre Dame and Ohio State for second place. USC moved alone into first with eight on April 24, 2024, when the Heisman Trust restored Reggie Bush's 2005 trophy. Alabama is next with four.

The Sooners' seven are Billy Vessels (1952), Steve Owens (1969), Billy Sims (1978), Jason White (2003), Sam Bradford (2008), Baker Mayfield (2017) and Kyler Murray (2018). Four of the seven came in a 16-year window from 2003 to 2018, the program's most concentrated Heisman run.

Mayfield and Murray gave OU a distinction no other school has: the first back-to-back Heisman-winning quarterbacks from the same program. Both also went No. 1 overall in the NFL Draft, and both played in Lincoln Riley's offense.

Since Murray's win in 2018, the trophy has gone elsewhere every year, through Travis Hunter of Colorado in 2024 and Fernando Mendoza of Indiana in 2025, so the seven-win tally holds through the 2025 award.
For trivia fans, the quick answer is this: USC has the most Heisman winners with eight, and Oklahoma is one of three schools right behind with seven.
